relations.statement: For a 2n-leg perfect tensor, every bipartition into k <= n inputs and 2n-k outputs yields a map proportional to an isometry.
relations.hypotheses: Pastawski et al. 2015 Section 2 Def. 2 p. 5; n=3 for the 6-qubit case

relations.statement: Stabilizer generators of the 5-qubit code pairwise commute.
relations.hypotheses: Laflamme et al. 1996 Table I; the code is the [[5,1,3]] stabilizer code

lemmas.statement: The source records a 2n-leg perfect tensor construction from the [[5,1,3]] code placed on the {5,4} tiling giving an isometric bulk-to-boundary code; this is recorded as a source claim and not proved here.

open_obligations: No Lean formalization of the 2n-leg perfect tensor bipartition isometry property exists in @SRC.
Construction of the 6-qubit perfect stabilizer tensor from the [[5,1,3]] code is not grounded in any listed declaration.
Placement on the {5,4} hyperbolic pentagon tiling and the isometric bulk-to-boundary property (Thm. 1) are not formalized.
Entanglement entropy S_A = |gamma_A| log v (Thm. 2) and greedy-geodesic bound (Thm. 3) are not grounded.
Numeric claim N_five_qubit_stabilizers is a placeholder arithmetic check, not a source quantity; it earns no credit.
